HomePage.meta_title: Panelo — a month of card news in one sitting
HomePage.meta_description: Turn one idea into Instagram, Reels, and Threads card news at once, then schedule it. You always see the estimate before any credit is spent.
HomePage.headline: A month of card news, in one sitting.
HomePage.subheadline: Stop rebuilding the same idea for every channel. Write the topic once and the channel cuts come with it, all the way through to scheduling.
HomePage.trust_note: 50 credits on sign-up · no card required
HomePage.fanout_visual_heading: How one source fans out into channel cuts
HomePage.features_heading: More channels, same amount of work.
HomePage.feature_fanout_body: Build the original once and each channel gets its own ratio and tone. 15 credits for the origin, 5 for every derived cut.
HomePage.feature_batch_body: Empty calendar slots open as a spreadsheet. Paste and drag to fill a whole month at once.
HomePage.feature_dryrun_body: You see the cost before you press run, every time. If generation fails, the credits come back automatically.
HomePage.how_heading: Three steps, then it is done.
HomePage.step_topic_body: One line is enough. For a batch, paste straight into the sheet.
HomePage.step_generate_body: See what it costs and run it. Regenerate only the cards you want to change.
HomePage.step_schedule_body: Set the publish time per channel and stop thinking about it.
HomePage.closing_heading: Finish this month's card news today.
